Definition: probably of Hebrew origin; Mainan, an Israelite:--Mainan.
BiblicalUsage: Mainan is a name in the genealogy of Jesus, in Luke 3:31, where he stands between Mattatha and Nathan, the son of David. The Greek text spells the name Menna, which is why the indexes carry it under that spelling.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in the genealogy is never filler: Mainan is one of the links that ties Jesus to David.
